Explain how decomposition and abstraction help when solving complex programming problems.

criteria: Clearly explains both decomposition and abstraction
Explains both concepts with limited detail
Includes at least one relevant example
Minimal explanation with little or no example

answer_options.sample_answer: Decomposition breaks a large problem into smaller tasks, while abstraction focuses on essential details and hides unnecessary complexity. Together they make systems easier to design, test, and maintain.
